mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( receiver_id, type, message, target_url ) VALUES ( #{receiverId}, #{type}, #{message}, #{targetUrl} )
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, receiver_id, type, message, target_url, read_at, created_at FROM notification WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND read_at IS NULL
